quote: I was spending roughly around $200 a month. Around 200. Sounds good. Yeah. You know, in the in the winter, it goes down to maybe 120. Then in the summer, it goes up to, like, 300.
stewart_read: Customer gives a full seasonal bill range unprompted — rep captures it but the response ('Sounds good') is filed, not flipped.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have been strategically deferring the emotional flip to the specialist call rather than doing it herself.
coaching_implication: Coach the rep to acknowledge the $300 summer peak specifically and connect it forward ('that summer number is exactly what solar is built to fix') rather than a generic 'sounds good.'

stewart_read: This is the rep's one real emotional reaction to the bill data, but it stays a reaction rather than becoming a bridge — no flip to align the pain against the utility.
alternative_hypothesis: The comment could be read as simple rapport-building small talk not intended to carry pitch weight.
coaching_implication: Show the rep this exact line as the missed pivot point — 'Jeez, that's crazy' is a free opening to say something like 'that's the kind of swing solar levels out.'

quote: Now we were thinking about adding a pool, which is one of the reasons I wanna go with solar.
stewart_read: Customer volunteers a major future load increase and explicitly names it as a reason for going solar — a strong qualifying signal the rep should anchor on.
coaching_implication: Rep noted it for the design file, which is correct, but never reflected it back to the customer as a reason this appointment matters — a missed curiosity-creation moment per coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features.

quote: I was actually referred to Ion by one of y'all's customers. I will have to get her name for you.
stewart_read: A referral name is dangling and unresolved — valuable for Ion's referral program, and the rep punts it entirely to the specialist without capturing any detail herself.
alternative_hypothesis: Punting the referral name to the specialist is reasonable scope discipline since it's not appointment-critical.
coaching_implication: A 15-second attempt to get even a partial name or the son-in-law's name would have been worth capturing live rather than fully deferring; flag as a light coaching note, not a major miss.

quote: Okay. I have a problem. Every time I try to scan the when I take a screenshot of the the the bar graph, it scrolls.
stewart_read: This is the third friction point in the same bill-collection stretch; rep offers no verbal read-back alternative and instead waits passively for the customer to solve it himself.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the customer was close to succeeding and chose not to interrupt his momentum with an alternate method.
coaching_implication: Coach a 2-minute rule: if screenshot attempts are failing, pivot immediately to 'just read me the number off the bar for the highest month' instead of letting the struggle continue.

quote: I will be Mhmm. I will be out of town Uh-huh. Thursday through Tuesday of next week. I won't be able to answer the phone, and I'll be out of country.
stewart_read: Customer surfaces a real scheduling constraint (an out-of-country window) right as the rep starts to book — this is a legitimate handoff-relevant fact, not a soft objection.
coaching_implication: Rep handled it correctly by booking before the travel window, but the closer needs to know about this travel gap in case of any reschedule need.

stewart_read: Customer books without hesitation once given options — the close itself required no persuasion, reflecting the warm state built earlier in the call.
coaching_implication: Nothing to fix here; note as an example of the customer's genuine motivation carrying the close despite mid-call energy dips.

quote: I have you on the schedule then for tomorrow, April 15 at 05:00 just for that phone call appointment with my specialist.
stewart_read: Rep confirms date and time but the button-up is thin — no explicit one-hour block statement, no 'is that fair?' handshake, no no-driving/computer instruction captured in the transcript.
alternative_hypothesis: These elements may have been covered off-transcript or considered implicit given the shorter phone-appointment format.
coaching_implication: Coach the rep to always close with the full button-up sequence — hour block, no-driving/computer expectation, and the fairness handshake — even on straightforward bookings.
